envelope.description: An optional object specifying the SMTP envelope used during email transmission. Only used when the message is delivered over SMTP

x-meta.usage:
Send this only when the SMTP envelope has to differ from the message headers, which in practice means variable envelope return paths, a bounce address that is not the From address, or delivering to an address that does not appear in the headers.

Left out, the envelope is derived from the headers, which is what you want for an ordinary message.

envelope.title: DraftSMTPEnvelope

copy.description: If set then either copies the message to the Sent Mail folder or not. If not set then uses the account's default setting

x-meta.usage:
Leave this unset to follow the account default. Set it explicitly when one message should be filed differently from the rest, for instance an automated notification you do not want in the user Sent folder.

It only affects SMTP deliveries. Gmail and MS Graph file sent messages themselves, so the flag is a no-op there.

sentMailPath.description: Upload sent message to this folder. By default the account's Sent Mail folder is used. Only applies to SMTP deliveries.

deliveryAttempts.description: How many delivery attempts to make until message is considered as failed

gateway.description: Optional SMTP gateway ID for message routing

dsn.description: Request DSN notifications. Only used when the message is delivered over SMTP.

id.description: The envelope identifier that would be included in the response (ENVID)

return.description: Specifies if only headers or the entire body of the message should be included in the response (RET)
return.title: DsnReturn

notify.description: Defines the conditions under which a DSN response should be sent

enumDescriptions.never: Never send a delivery status notification
enumDescriptions.success: Notify when the message is delivered
enumDescriptions.failure: Notify when the message cannot be delivered
enumDescriptions.delay: Notify when the message is delayed

notify.title: DsnNotify

recipient.description: The email address the DSN should be sent (ORCPT)

dsn.title: DraftDSN

proxy.description: Optional proxy URL to use when connecting to the SMTP server. A token with restricted permissions can not set this - it redirects a session that carries the account credentials

localAddress.description: Optional local IP address to bind to when connecting to the SMTP server
